title: Acceleration expression
description: Essential: The response must state the correct formula for the electron's acceleration, a = eU/(md).

title: Deflection distance expression
description: Essential: The response must state the correct final formula for the deflection distance, Δy = eUL²/(2mdv₀²).

title: Force and Newton's law
description: Important: The solution should correctly relate the electric force (F = eE = eU/d) to acceleration via F = ma.

title: Kinematics application
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the time of flight (t = L/v₀) and apply it in the uniformly accelerated motion equation (Δy = ½at²).

title: Direction of force/acceleration
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution incorrectly uses the sign of the electron's charge, leading to a wrong direction for force or acceleration, though magnitude may be correct.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Award credit if the student explicitly checks or discusses the dimensional consistency of their final expressions.

title: Field uniformity assumption
description: Optional: Award credit if the solution explicitly notes the use of the uniform electric field assumption (E = U/d).
